1081	enters the covenant of Avraham Avinu. A convert cannot convert without fulfilling the mitzvah of

1083	So, what do we see in these three stories?
1084	That HaShem says to the Jew: you want to enter this infinite path
1085	of connecting the higher and the lower, of connecting the limitless with the limited,
1086	connecting the level of Godliness above the world with the world, then first of all you must go,
1087	"Lech," first of all leave what you are used to.
1088	Second, understand that you have a mission.

1095	the Jews.
1096	And afterward you seal this in your flesh, in an eternal covenant, through which
1097	the eternal connection is completed.
1098	So what comes out of this?
1099	It comes out, as we said before, that Kadosh Baruch Hu is "was, is, and will be" as one.
1100	With Kadosh Baruch Hu you cannot ask what is relevant about something that once was; what was, was.
1101	Why can't you ask such a question?
1102	Because what was is the present, and it is what will be.
1103	Just as what will be is what was.
1104	Limited man is not in this experience.
1105	But when a Jew understands what Judaism is, as we said, the Torah in our parashah reveals to us
1106	what Judaism is.
1107	What is Judaism?
1108	Judaism is the connection of two opposite matters: of
1109	the high place of "was, is, and will be," which is the higher ones, and of the low place, which is limited reality,
1110	which we earlier called the reality of the boxes, and the recognition that as a Jew
1111	you can connect them in such a way that you do not diminish the revelation of the Infinite, do not give
1112	it up, and you do not give up the reality of the world.
1113	You do not...
1114	or what is called, nullify the physical and the material.
1115	You succeed in finding inconceivable ways, from the power of the Infinite
1116	in the soul, in the hidden powers of the soul, to pour
1117	all the Infinite into reality, and to elevate reality, and to bring it
1118	to union with the Infinite of Kadosh Baruch Hu.

1131	I am truly going to the unknown, for who among us can know the Infinite?

1137	infinite purpose?

1139	the Infinite exists.
1140	Truly the Infinite will connect with reality.
1141	Therefore it is an eternal reality.
1142	Let us give a simple analogy.
1143	Can any of us experience infinity?
1144	On the face of it, no.
1145	Everything we do has a beginning and an end.
1146	But notice just one thing.
1147	Each of us wants to live forever.

1149	Will we still want to live forever?
1150	What will happen in another thousand years?
1151	What will happen in another million years?
1152	What will happen in another billion years?
1153	There will be a certain moment.

1155	That is, in the inner will to live, there a person can,
1156	in his feeling, in his consciousness, feel what eternity is, what infinity is.
1157	Everything has a beginning and an end, but the will to live has no beginning and no end.

1159	Hu.
